prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Havenline World1 appearance-upgrade proposal sheet. Produce a polished chunky rounded stylized3D reference sheet on a clean navy studio background. Warm timber, rounded blue steel, restrained orange mechanisms, soft sculpted snow on cold surfaces; no photoreal grit, primitive placeholders or sci-fi redesign. EXACTLY TWO new named appearance stages, arranged in TWO rows and THREE columns. Each row depicts the same coherent stage in FRONT THREE-QUARTER, REAR THREE-QUARTER, and FUNCTIONAL SIDE/DETAIL views. All six panels remain readable and uncropped. Keep camera elevation, object scale, floor footprint and lighting comparable; only camera changes within a stage. Never mirror ports or flip mechanisms between panels. No people, crew, pets, scenery, UI, level numbers, stat values, prices, capacities, watermarks or new resource names. The original base remains unchanged and is NOT a third row. These are authored visual proposals, not approved numerical upgrades, unlock levels, runtime animation or balance. Numeric equipment/world-level binding remains pending. Preserve the existing belt and resource scale; no new conveyor appearance or enlarged cargo. Show only a few representative existing inputs/outputs where needed for functional clarity, not full industrial scenes.

Primary subject: Fish-line intake and automation.
Input image roles:
1. Existing selected baseline design: preserve recognizable silhouette, material family, footprint and the physical side/height/order of all inputs, outputs, controls and service positions. This request adds authored appearance concepts; it does not replace the retained base.
2. Retained food machine identities, whole-fish route and selected conveyor/resource handoff scale.
3. Owner-selected ordinary resource/cash size and unchanged character scale. Scale reference only; do not add a person or resize resources in output.
4. Owner-selected low orange/yellow conveyor, black rollers and transfer plate. Preserve belt width/height and machine handoff relationships; no new belt appearance proposals.

TOP ROW — Reinforced Fish Intake: Strengthen the same intake frame and guide surfaces with restrained metal brackets and an accessible manual control.
BOTTOM ROW — Sheltered Fish Intake: Add a fitted blue protective hood and reinforced guides, retaining the same opening, transfer height and handoff side.

Asset-specific invariants: This is the existing fish intake/line-support asset, not a second independent cooker. Preserve raw whole-fish intake and its handoff to the existing cooker; do not show cooked output from an uncooked intake or invent a fillet step. Preserve approved fish and conveyor scale. Fish is later World1 scope, not initial Level1 content.

Text: use only the asset name, the two exact stage names above, and short view captions FRONT / REAR / DETAIL. No level numbers, prices, quantities or stats.
Mandatory camera audit: column1 FRONT shows the actual front. Column2 REAR must show the opposite back of the SAME object, so physically left/right attachments reverse screen sides; do not merely rotate the front slightly and label it REAR. Column3 DETAIL must reveal functional contact/clearance. Keep all corresponding parts attached to the same physical sides. Preserve each stage across its three views. Preserve the two rear cylindrical open intake cages, two orange sloped feeder lanes with silver beds and the ONE centered low black-roller handoff at the front. Rear view must foreground both circular cage mouths, front view must foreground black rollers. Any blue protective cover must leave both intake mouths, feeder paths and front discharge open. No heating, flame, smoke or cooked fish.
